BridgeCommand.description: Frontend -> Rust. Only whitelisted actions may be invoked; anything else must be rejected on the Rust side.

BridgeEvent.description: Rust -> frontend. Errors inside payloads must already be mapped to the UnifiedError shape; raw Rust errors, stack traces and system paths must not be passed through.

description: Phase 0 skeleton. Rust <-> TS bridge contract. This replaces the macOS-only endoHatch bridge with a cross-platform equivalent: action + typed payload + requestId, whitelisted commands only, versioned so a mismatch fails loudly at startup.
title: BridgeContract
